title: DeployConfig
description: Per-app, per-environment deploy values (deploy/<env>.yml). Carries WHAT to run, with which knobs, and the AWS resource coordinates to run it against — never deploy logic (that lives in cd-template.yml) and never secret values.

apiVersion.description: Version of the deploy-config contract this file targets. 'cd/v1' today; a breaking format change ships as 'cd/v2' so existing repos keep resolving. An unknown value fails validation.

name.description: App identifier; must match the CI artifact name.

target.description: Deploy target — selects the branch of cd-template.yml that runs.

region.description: Optional override of the region in deploy-defaults.yml.

version.description: Immutable artifact ref to deploy: image digest (sha256:...), Lambda zip sha, or static bundle id. Empty is allowed only for env 'dev' (deploys the latest published artifact).

strategy.description: rolling: all targets; blue-green: ecs/ec2 via CodeDeploy; canary: lambda alias shift.

infra.description: AWS resource coordinates the deploy runs against. Filled in per environment when the resources are created; read directly by cd-template.yml from this file. Only the sub-block matching service.target is required.

account.description: AWS account id for this environment. One set of accounts per app (not org-wide), so it lives here rather than in deploy-defaults.yml. Substituted into deployRolePattern as {account}.

region.description: Optional override of environment.region / deploy-defaults region for the AWS calls in this deploy.

service.description: ECS service name; also the task-definition family.

containerName.description: Name of the container in the task def whose image is swapped.

repository.description: ECR repository URI (registry/host + path), no tag/digest.

codedeploy.description: Required when release.strategy is blue-green (ecs/ec2) or for target ec2.

artifact.description: CI artifact bucket the deploy pulls zips/bundles from (target ec2 / lambda).

runtime.description: ecs / ec2 / lambda runtime knobs. Ignored for target s3.

cpu.description: ECS task CPU units / Lambda memory hint.

env.description: Non-secret environment variables. Secrets go in `secrets`, never here.

secrets.description: Secret NAMES only — resolved from Secrets Manager at deploy time by cd-template.yml. Never values.

healthcheck.description: ALB / target-group health check. ecs/ec2 only.

sourceDir.description: Directory inside the build artifact to sync.
